Under the proposed plan, one spouse would need to work at least 35 hours a week, while the other stays home - but single parents and unmarried couples would not qualify. The money would come from an existing federal childcare fund that already helps lower- and middle-income families cover the cost of care, rather than creating an entirely new program.
